text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Arima Kinen, the racecourse is packed with spectators who've been looking forward to the showdown between the BNW trio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket tells Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide that she's pumped and ready to go for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the runners dash off onto the track, they are welcomed by thunderous cheers.
